blurb: Guests rent a self-captained boat to spend time with friends and loved ones on the Milwaukee River. The boat is a 2023 Sylvan/Sun Chaser with a capacity of ten people. Rentals allow travel anywhere on the Milwaukee River within the breakwater, including KK River to Barnacle Buds or Menomonee River to Twisted Fisherman.
extraNote: Capacity of ten people maximum on the boat · No individual glassware like beer bottles allowed; liquor and wine bottles allowed · No bathroom on board; may stop at public docks and must purchase something to use restrooms · Must remain within the breakwater as per Coast Guard law
